method: Global world BVH; exact segment-triangle distance for capsule at each sample. Two-sided visible mesh surfaces, not solid occupancy nor UE5 collision. Grid .25 m; routes <=.05 m. Ground ray starts z=.60, slope abs normal <=45 degrees. No crouch/jump/step simulation.
